query: Show me the code graph of this project so I can see what depends on what.
expected_output: Finds the plugin root two directories above the SKILL.md, runs node <root>/tools/graph/graph.mjs render from the project root (which refreshes the index first), takes the path it prints (default .grimoire/graph/graph.html) and opens it locally with open or xdg-open. Says the page is a map and stays local.

expectations.text: Runs tools/graph/graph.mjs render from the plugin root, from the project root
Opens the printed file locally with open or xdg-open
Does not publish, upload or share the page

query: Rebuild the graph index, it's never been built here.
expected_output: Checks grimoire.config.json for graph.enabled, runs node <root>/tools/graph/graph.mjs index (the script, not a model reading files), notes that the first run installs the parser runtime once per machine, and reports the per-repo counts it prints. Offers to render the page afterwards.

expectations.text: Builds the index with the graph.mjs index script, not by reading files and extracting relations itself
Reports the counts the script printed

query: Open the run log for last night's loop run.
expected_output: The run log is the logs skill's job (scripts/render-logs.mjs). The graph skill is not used: no graph page is rendered.

expectations.text: Does not render the code graph page

expected_output: A narrow graph question is answered with the graph_callers tool (or a scout), then confirmed in the code; it does not need the HTML page, so the graph skill is not used.

expectations.text: Does not render the page for a single lookup

query: Open the code graph and show me how the backend's modules depend on each other, and what calls StreamWrapper.send_message.
expected_output: Renders the page with graph.mjs render and opens it locally. Points the user at the Map tab's system map (one lane per repository, modules linked by the file pairs that use each other) and at the symbol's neighbourhood (search it, or the #sym-<id> anchor): callers on the left, callees on the right, test code and ambiguous links hidden until their toggles are on. Reminds that links are matched by name and confirms anything it states in the code at the path:line.

expectations.text: Renders and opens the page locally rather than answering from graph tools alone
Directs the user to the system map for module dependencies and to the symbol's neighbourhood for its callers
Says test code and ambiguous links are hidden by default and how to show them
